segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the billing contact email?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Dan with Lakeside Field Services. Billing email is ap@lakesidefield.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I have the account up in the billing tool. What can I help with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Our March statement, invoice 43892, shows a $620 implementation add-on, but we finished implementation last November and it wasn't on the February invoice.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, I see invoice 43892 dated March 1 for $3,870 total. Let me check the line history and the account notes, one second.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We just need to close our month-end by Friday, so I wanted to catch it before payment runs.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, so I found the note. That add-on was attached to the account by mistake when your renewal quote was copied on February 26. Your active subscription is 42 seats on the Growth plan, monthly billing, no implementation items.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I expected.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I’m removing that line and issuing a corrected invoice now. The revised total will be $3,250, same due date of March 15. You’ll get the PDF at ap@lakesidefield.com in about five minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Can you put a note on the ticket for our records?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Already done. Ticket 72184 has the correction note and the old invoice is marked superseded in the billing tool.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, thanks. That’s all I needed.
